# Vendored drawing source

`index.html` is the unmodified drawing source from [Lingdong Huang's {Shan, Shui}*](https://github.com/LingDong-/shan-shui-inf), pinned to commit [`9f754d2b2e73495db7883d4d4055a7b0903b0454`](https://github.com/LingDong-/shan-shui-inf/tree/9f754d2b2e73495db7883d4d4055a7b0903b0454).

`source.json` records the upstream repository, commit, and SHA-256 checksum. [LICENSE](LICENSE) preserves the original MIT license and copyright notice. The adapter and sample composition live in the experiment's `scripts/` directory.

These notes describe the vendored files; they are not the upstream project's README.
